caption: The drawing depicts a single woven basket placed centrally on a plain, light-colored background. The basket is circular in shape with an open top, and its construction features a closely interlaced pattern of what appears to be strips of a natural material, shown in various tones of brown, from light tan to deeper, golden-brown hues. The depiction captures the arrangement of the weaving, with overlapping bands creating a textured, three-dimensional appearance. The interior and exterior of the basket are both visible, and shading is used to suggest depth and the curvature of the object. There are no other objects or details present in the composition.
title: Bread Basket
